newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vedior unit Abilis in talks with PreNed.
newsitem.headline: Vedior unit Abilis in talks with PreNed.

text.p: Business services group Vedior said on Thursday its cleaning business Abilis was in talks with Facilicom Bedrijfsdiensten aimed at combining the security activities of Abilis with Facilicom unit PreNed Beveiliging.

Abilis also said the cleaning business of Facilicom in Luxembourg and Orleans in France were to be transferred to Abilis as it concentrated more on its core business of general and specialised cleaning activities.
Abilis said it was looking for partners for Nedsafe and Hodon Winkel Beveiliging, with turnover of some 20 million guilders, with security services as a main business.
Abilis has turnover of 1.3 billion guilders in 1996.
Facilicom brand names are beside PreNed, GOM Schoonhouden, Prorest Catering and Breijer technical maintenance.
